tweet.text: We then run a series of LM agents constructed from Anthropic’s Claude 3.5 Sonnet and OpenAI’s o1-preview on RE-Bench. The best Claude and o1-preview agents do substantially better than humans given 2 hours, but human experts improve performance at a much quicker rate over time.
